targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-903 FAIL (2026-08-08): First attempt at MECH-075 ventral/VTA-RPE leg. Self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue, confirmed correct on adjudication: P0 readiness passed in only 1/3 seeds (seed 7), with the other two showing negative grounding correlation (-0.04, -0.08). The top-level manifest preconditions[].met: true reflects a seed-mean statistic dominated by seed 7 and should not be read as readiness cleared -- the seed-majority gate (summary.n_p0a_pass=1) is authoritative and correctly failed. Seed 7's apparent pass coincides with ~25x fewer eval samples than the other seeds, consistent with near-immediate episode termination -- a plausible sampling confound, not confirmed training success. Uninformative about the ventral-leg claim; re-queue with per-seed episode-termination recording before trusting a future P0 read.
learning_extracted: Seed-mean precondition statistics can obscure a majority-gate FAIL when one outlier seed dominates the mean -- always read summary.n_p0a_pass/n_p0b_pass, never the top-level preconditions[].met
Anomalously small per-seed sample counts (episode length) are a detectable, cheap-to-check confound for seed-heterogeneous readiness results

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-905 FAIL (2026-08-08): First non-degenerate manipulation test of the MECH-075 dorsal/LC-arousal leg -- P0 and C1 (signal detectability + correct LC-anatomical targeting) both cleanly passed, correcting the signal-magnitude defect of all three prior attempts (EXQ-192a/209/230). However, C2 (basin-width widening) failed with near-zero, sign-inconsistent gaps (relative gap ~1e-6 against a 15% floor). Traced to substrate code (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py _compute_mode_noise_scale/propose_trajectories): the manipulation gain LC_GAIN=2.0 -- inherited unchanged from the already-failed EXQ-192a novelty_gain=2.0 -- produces only a ~0.4-0.6% CEM-proposal-noise increase at the observed (post-fix) arousal_ema magnitude (~0.002-0.003), an order of magnitude too small to plausibly produce a 15%-scale basin-width change. This reads as an underpowered manipulation (test-design gap), not a falsification of the mechanism: reclassified from the filed weakens to measurement_test_design_defect. Re-queue with LC_GAIN recalibrated against the observed EMA distribution (target mode_scale range ~1.1-1.3, by analogy with the sibling ventral script's explicit RPE_GAIN derivation) before this criterion can be considered fairly tested.
learning_extracted: A gain constant gating CEM proposal noise off a small-magnitude (O(1e-3)) EMA must be re-derived per probe against the observed signal distribution -- reusing a constant from a prior FAILed design silently underpowers the manipulation even after the detectability floor is independently fixed
criteria_non_degenerate flags on a near-zero, sign-varying gap distinguish 'not a hard bug' from 'effect size adequate' -- they do not certify the latter
